reuse_policy.new_generation_condition: Generate only when existing panels cannot accurately communicate the required scene beats.

assets.setting: warm contemporary home entryway in morning light

panels.description: Parent checks the time while child folds her arms beside red and blue shoes.
Tense parent points toward shoes while child turns away.
Parent pauses to think while child remains turned away.

assets.setting: warm contemporary family living room in late-afternoon or early-evening light

panels.description: Child is absorbed in an unbranded tablet on the sofa while the parent approaches and notices the transition time.

Parent and child reconnect by building blocks together with the tablet put away in the background.
